subject: English
title: English 8 (PECTAA, SNC)
questions: What does 'tolerance' mean, as explained in the lesson?
Bearing pain or hardships with patience
Tolerance means to bear pain or hardships with patience, and to bear things you do not like.
At the conquest of Makkah, how did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) treat Abu Sufyan?
He forgave Abu Sufyan and declared amnesty for those who took refuge in his house.
Who did Allah send to the Holy Prophet (PBUH) after the people of Taif stoned him?
Allah sent the Angel of the Mountains, who offered to crush the people between two mountains.
What did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) reply to the Angel of the Mountains?
No; I hope their children will worship Allah alone
He said no, hoping that Allah would let them beget children who worship Allah alone.
For how many years did Hazrat Anas bin Malik serve the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
Hazrat Anas said, 'I served the Rasoolullah for 10 years.'
According to Hazrat Ayesha, the Holy Prophet (PBUH) never:
Hazrat Ayesha said the Rasoolullah never took revenge upon anyone.
Amnesty is a general pardon, as declared at the conquest of Makkah.
Where did the kind old man in 'A Great Virtue' live?
In a small hut in a forest
He lived all alone in a small hut in a forest.
Who knocked first at the old man's door on the stormy night?
The first visitor was a hunter looking for shelter.
Who was the second person to knock at the door?
The second knock was a farmer asking for shelter.
Who came last, shivering with cold?
A woman with her two small children
A woman came with her two small children, shivering with cold.
Who told the old man not to open the door again?
The farmer objected; afterwards he felt guilty and apologised for being selfish.
How did everyone spend the night in the hut?
The whole crowd spent the stormy night standing in the little hut, chatting.
What great virtue did the old man show?
The old man was kind and always ready to share with others.
'The Twins' is by Henry Sambrooke Leigh.
Who mixed up the twins in the poem?
'As we were being washed by nurse, we got completely mixed.'
What was the name of the speaker's brother?
'My brother John was named me, and I was named him.'
The tone of the poem 'The Twins' is mainly:
The poem humorously describes the confusion caused by the twins' likeness.
The poet asks everyone: 'What would you do, if you were me, to prove that you were ___?'
The poem ends: 'What would you do, if you were me, to prove that you were you?'
rise and fall of the voice in speaking
Intonation is the rise and fall of the voice in speaking.
Henry S. Leigh was born in:
Henry Sambrooke Leigh was born in London on 29 March 1837.
Most people killed in road accidents, according to the lesson, are:
Most of the victims of road accidents are young people below 30 years of age.
According to research, about what percentage of traffic accidents take place due to drivers' mistakes or negligence?
Almost 80% of traffic accidents take place due to the mistake or negligence of drivers.
The most crucial factor causing road fatalities is:
Over speeding is the most crucial factor causing fatalities or injuries.
Any violation of a traffic law is an offence.
By observing traffic laws we can avoid accidents, save lives and improve our:
Observing traffic laws saves lives and improves our country's image.
Who was the second Caliph of Islam?
Hazrat Umar (RA) was the second Caliph of Islam.
Hazrat Umar (RA) belonged to which tribe?
He was born at Makkah Mukarramah into a noble tribe of the Quraish.
For how long did Hazrat Umar (RA) remain Caliph?
He remained Caliph for ten and a half years.
Which reform did Hazrat Umar (RA) introduce to investigate complaints against state offices?
He introduced administrative courts to investigate complaints against the offices of the state.
How did Hazrat Umar (RA) treat the worship places of non-Muslims?
The worship places and property of non-Muslims were given protection.
Hazrat Umar (RA) gave great importance to:
He gave great importance to justice and would not spare anyone in judgement.
What does the proverb 'mens sana in corpore sano' mean?
A healthy mind in a healthy body
The ancient Roman proverb means 'A healthy mind in a healthy body'.
What is the national game of Pakistan?
Hockey is the national game of Pakistan.
Through sports, young people learn values such as:
Sports teach honesty, teamwork, fair play, respect and adherence to rules.
Mental strength can be achieved through indoor games like:
Indoor sports like chess build mental power; outdoor sports improve physical health.
Between which years did Pakistan record extraordinary hockey conquests?
Pakistan recorded extraordinary hockey conquests between 1956 and 1986.
fair play, ethical behaviour and integrity
Sportsmanship is an understanding of and commitment to fair play, ethical behaviour and integrity.
In the poem 'The Earth Speaks', who addresses the reader?
'The turning earth spoke in a somber voice.'
What gifts does the Earth give us in the poem?
'Four seasons I give you,' the Earth said.
According to the poem, spring is when the ___ bloom.
'I give you spring when the lilacs bloom.'
In autumn, according to the poem, the maple is:
'I give you autumn when the maple is red.'
What task does the Earth give the readers?
Use each season wisely, kindly and well
'Take my four gifts and use each one, use each wisely, kindly and well.'
A figure of speech that gives human qualities to non-human things is called:
Personification attributes human characteristics to non-human things, like the Earth speaking.
'He is a fish out of water' is an example of:
A metaphor compares two things without using 'like' or 'as'.
A simile compares two things using the words:
A simile compares two things using 'like' or 'as'.
A wise old man who settled quarrels
Haji Usman was a wise old man respected for his piety, who often settled quarrels.
He lived in a little village near Faisalabad.
Who were the two men quarrelling?
The two men were Haroon and Salman, his neighbours.
What was the cause of their quarrel?
Salman's tractor destroyed some of Haroon's crops
Salman had accidentally destroyed some of Haroon's crops by driving his tractor through his fields.
What did Haji Usman do first to settle the quarrel?
Listened to both men in turn
He knew he had to listen to them both in turn before deciding.
In the poem about anger in Unit 8, which is a way to calm down?
'I can count to ten... I can breathe slow and deep' to calm myself down.
Who first conquered Mount Everest in 1953?
Tenzing Norgay and Sir Edmund Hillary
Tenzing and Sir Edmund Hillary conquered Mount Everest in 1953.
Why is mountaineering called a risky sport?
It involves the highest risk and danger
Mountain climbing is risky and dangerous, yet full of thrill and adventure.
Which famous Pakistani climber lost his life attempting K2 in winter 2021?
Muhammad Ali Sadpara, who had climbed eight of the world's highest mountains, died on K2 in winter 2021.
Why do climbers need artificial oxygen at great heights?
Oxygen becomes less, making breathing difficult
As one climbs up, oxygen becomes less, so artificial oxygen is essential.
How has training in proper equipment affected mountaineering?
Training with advanced tools and kits has reduced the risks, though lives are still lost.
Equal respect for all forms of work
Dignity of labour means equal respect for all work, including manual labour.
According to the lesson, farmers are the ___ of every country.
Farmers are the backbone of every country; they grow the food we eat.
What would happen if farmers stopped cultivating crops?
If farmers stop cultivating crops there will be famine and starvation.
Which crops does Ahmad's father grow?
Ahmad's father farms crops of wheat, barley and rice.
Where did Ahmad's father study agriculture?
His father received an agricultural education from Faisalabad Agriculture University.
What did Saad and his sister make in the kitchen?
Saad helped his little sister make a vegetable sandwich using a recipe.
In Pakistan's flag, the white colour represents:
The green colour represents the Muslim majority and the white represents minorities.
What is the largest lake of Pakistan, according to Alia's article?
The article lists Manchar Lake as the largest lake.
What is the longest river of Pakistan?
The Indus River is the longest river of Pakistan.
What is the height of K-2 given in the article?
Which dam of Pakistan is the world's largest earth-filled dam?
Tarbela Dam is the world's largest earth-filled dam.
Which of these is NOT listed among the top places to visit in the article?
The list includes Swat, Hunza, Yarkhun and Kalash Valleys and Margala Hills.
What is the official name of Pakistan?
The official name is the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
